title: App & Website Super Slow!
author: Shambhavi8
body: Nykaa Fashion has such a great curation of brands, but I find it extremely difficult to enjoy a good shopping experience simply because both, the app and the website, are ridiculously slow to navigate. Online shopping is supposed to be a fun and quick way to get your shopping done. But even the simplest tasks take forever - adding an item to the cart, adding an item to wish list, moving an item from wish list to cart or vice versa. Not once has it happened instantly. Every time it shows the loading symbol with the Nykaa logo animation. It is genuinely frustrating to spend triple the amount of time to navigate and sort your cart. There are so many times I don’t end up using Nykaa Fashion simply because I don’t have the time. It’s bizarre. Please please work towards creating a more efficient app and website, with quick processing of inputs. Also, a huge tip - please add the “wish list” shortcut to the items on their thumbnails itself in the app and the website. Half the times on the web, even after you open the product page it only shows “add to bag” option. It’s bizarre.

By that time I had to catch a flight and dropped a note to the team to kindly accept my return/exchange if required once I am back and can try the product. They used a loophole to say that I didn’t mention it very clearly in the email and they used it as an excuse to not accept my return* The amazing customer care rep repeated the 2 day return window without understanding the concern or they have been asked not to care. * Basically they can delay the deliveries but despite informing over email in prior, they won’t accept a return/exchange after 4 days. * Half of the products either don’t have a return window or is for 2 days only. * Misleading pictures, same product is available as a set and as a separate product (eg.
